records.title: 10-Q
records.text: IET revenue increased $0.4 billion, or 15%, driven by strong growth in Gas Technology Equipment ("GTE") and Gas Technology Services ("GTS").

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the third quarter of 2025, the Company generated revenues of $7.0 billion, an increase of $0.1 billion, or 1%, compared to the third quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: OFSE revenue decreased $0.3 billion, or 8%, led by a decline in international revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net income was $0.6 billion, a decrease of $0.2 billion, or 20%, compared to the third quarter of 2024, with a decline in the market-to-market adjustment of certain equity securities, decreased volume, lower cost productivity, and transaction costs, partially offset by structural cost out initiatives, price, and favorable FX.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities were $2,148 million and $2,142 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
